title: Smoky Australian Tamarind Skewers
description: A fusion of Australian flavors with a smoky twist, these skewers are perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes before use.
Thread Australian shrimp, quietly grilled pineapple, and a small amount of smoky barbecue sauce onto each skewer.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve immediately with additional smoky barbecue sauce, if desired.
